name: Missouri
source: Missouri Department of Revenue 2026 Withholding Tax Formula (read 2026-10-22): rates 0% to 4.7% in 1,348 steps, top rate over 9,436, standard deduction 16,100 / 32,200; Tax Foundation 2026 state income tax table agrees; HB 594 (2025) capital gains subtraction (Kutak Rock, RSM alerts)

state_base.note: Missouri starts from federal adjusted (or taxable) income and keeps the federal treatment of 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits (no add-back; only California and New Jersey tax HSA deposits). Not checked against a state ruling.

standard_deduction.note: Missouri uses the federal standard deduction (16,100 / 32,200 for 2026; MO DOR withholding formula, primary, and Tax Foundation 2026). Not modelled: the deduction for federal income tax paid (up to 5,000 / 10,000, shrinking with AGI).

exemptions.note: No exemptions; senior is the federal additional standard deduction for 65 or older (1,650 married; 2,050 single), assumed to carry into the Missouri standard deduction (confirmed primary: https://dor.mo.gov/taxation/individual/tax-types/income/year-changes/, validation run 2, 2026-10-22). Brackets: indexed for inflation each year (1,313 steps in 2025, 1,348 in 2026; DOR year changes page, https://dor.mo.gov/taxation/individual/tax-types/income/year-changes/, confirmed primary, validation run 2, 2026-10-22), so the file flags them indexed and the whole return grows with inflation.

capital_gains_exclusion.note: HB 594 (signed 2025-07-10): individuals subtract 100% of the capital gains on their federal return from tax year 2025 (Kutak Rock and RSM alerts agree, confirmed primary: https://dor.mo.gov/taxation/individual/tax-types/income/year-changes/, validation run 2, 2026-10-22). The model passes only long-term gains here, so short-term gains stay taxed (they are exempt in law).

estate_inheritance.check_at: Tax Foundation estate and inheritance tax map (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/estate-inheritance-taxes/)
estate_inheritance.note: Missouri has no estate tax and no inheritance tax (Tax Foundation 2026 estate and inheritance tax map and state-costs.csv columns estate_tax and inheritance_tax agree).

social_security.note: Missouri exempts all Social Security benefits from tax year 2024 (state-costs.csv ss_taxed 'N (2024+)', Kiplinger 2026 and AARP Missouri tax guide agree). Not modelled: the public pension exemption (up to the maximum Social Security benefit) and the private pension exemption (6,000 per person, only under AGI 25,000 single / 32,000 joint, phased out above). Confirmed primary on https://dor.mo.gov/faq/taxation/individual/pension.html (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Kansas City earnings tax (kcmo.gov) and City of St. Louis earnings tax (stlouis-mo.gov) pages
local_income_tax.note: Kansas City and St. Louis city each charge a 1% earnings tax on residents' wages and self-employment earnings (not on pensions, Social Security or investment income). Their residents are about 13% of Missourians (about 510,000 and 280,000 of 6.2 million, from memory), so the state average is about 0.13% of wages. A household in either city pays 1%, elsewhere nothing (state-costs.csv local_income_tax; population shares unconfirmed).

sales_tax.check_at: Missouri revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: 0.0844 from the state's own source (Missouri state 4.225% plus the local taxes of the buyer's city and county, so the combined rate (https://dor.mo.gov/faq/motor-vehicle/titling-registration.html, validation run 3)). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.01225) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: yes); research note: Reduced state food rate 1.225% (1% + 0.225% conservation/parks); full local rates apply. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.source: Missouri DOR motor vehicle fees page: passenger vehicle of 12 to 23 taxable horsepower 21.25 for one year (search extract, 2026-10-23)
car_taxes.note: Floor: the registration fee of a typical passenger car. The processing fee (9 a year) and the county personal property tax on cars (research note: high) are not included, so the real cost is higher. Set by hand (s328, 2026-10-23, owner decision C4: no 0 that only means unknown); a move changes the entered car tax by the dollar difference of the two states' figures, and the importer keeps a non-zero figure.

fuel.source: Excise: https://dor.mo.gov/taxation/business/tax-types/motor-fuel/ (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.295 ($0.295 from 2025-07-01); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Missouri insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
